summary: Core change is correct and tested; it also carries a large unrelated auto-format rewrite of commands.py, adopt.py, test_adopt.py and test_commands.py that buries the real diff.

findings.summary: Commits for T002/T003 rewrap many unrelated lines (88-column auto-format) in adopt.py, commands.py, test_adopt.py and test_commands.py, mixing a formatter pass into behaviour commits.
findings.evidence: ENG-29 (focused, reviewable changes). Repo has no formatter or line-length config (no pyproject/ruff/.editorconfig); base commands.py already has 17 lines >88 columns, so long lines are neighbouring style. Examples with no behavioural link: adopt.py _resolve/_unmatched/_spec_dir/_rollback/_add_worktree/_record_worktree_run rewraps; commands.py import-block explosion, find_matches, cmd_answer/cmd_decisions_add/cmd_verify die() rewraps; test_adopt.py hunks such as the AdoptRollbackTests branch-list assertion and the extra blank line before `if __name__`. adopt.py diff is 104 lines for a ~10-line change (_commit_run pathspec).
findings.fix: Revert the formatting-only hunks in those four files, keeping only the pathspec changes (commit_worktree, _commit_run, the new tests and imports). Matching the surrounding unwrapped style also satisfies ENG-7.
